title: VibeInfrastructureLockfile
description: JSON Schema for Vibe Infrastructure lockfile (vibe.lock) tracking resolved Git commits and dependencies.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last synchronization or modification.

infrastructures.description: Active infrastructure dependencies and their resolved commit states.

url.description: Git repository URL of the AI infra.

version.description: Concrete resolved Git Tag, branch, or pinned version.

resolvedCommit.description: Exact Git commit SHA resolved during synchronization.
